summary: The chart package's change journal (standard simai.change-lifecycle 1.0.0): a public name of a chart component that is renamed or removed is recorded here in the free journal's record form, with its dates.

records.summary: sf-chart-metric is the dated alias of SIMAI Framework's sf-tile-metric (decision C168; the SIMAI Framework dispatcher's task K-10; docs/DECISIONS.md D19): the metric tile moved to the Framework as sf-tile-metric, which took over sf-chart-metric 0.1.0's settings by name and has a chart slot that takes sf-chart-sparkline, and the former tag keeps working until remove_after. As with sf-message-log and sf-list-feed (ui-source journal record tag-sf-message-log-to-sf-list-feed), the set ships the alias element itself (src/smart/chart-metric 1.0.0): a subclass of the class that defines sf-tile-metric, which also maps the former names (the data-state setting, the event sf-chart-metric-open, three public variables --sf-chart-metric-*) and gives its tag row at runtime (registerTagAliasRows). The Framework's static tag table does not carry the row while the set defines the element.

examples.after: <sf-tile-metric label="Выручка" value="1250000" previous="1100000" loading><sf-chart-sparkline slot="chart" label="Выручка по дням"></sf-chart-sparkline></sf-tile-metric>

records.manual: Write <sf-tile-metric> for <sf-chart-metric>; the settings keep their names. data-state="loading" is loading (data-state="empty" goes: no value already reads «—»); listen for sf-tile-metric-open (detail {id}) for sf-chart-metric-open; --sf-tile-metric-background-color, -value-color and -hover-background-color for the same --sf-chart-metric-* variables; -label-color, -positive-color, -negative-color and -meter-color have no counterpart (the tile takes the status tones); -min-inline-size is --sf-tile-metric-min-width on a .sf-tile-metric-grid row. The tag alone is not a mechanical rename, because data-state lives only on the alias element.
records.source: package/src/smart/chart-metric (component.json x-decisions, docs.md «Переход с sf-chart-metric»); ui-source src/smart/tile-metric at 10145e63 (x-decisions C168)
